title: Link send can hang when a different queued head fails terminally
description: Final ACK correctness review: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py:897-911 terminally removes only the reserved head after radio false/exception, then breaks or raises. If a higher-priority preloaded entry is ahead of the frame enqueued by send(), that caller's reservation remains queued and await reservation.wait() never resolves; on exception the caller observes failure while its frame remains eligible for later delivery. Terminal drain failure must resolve/remove every affected queued reservation, or continue draining with precise per-entry outcomes, so no send hangs and no frame survives an error result. Add deterministic priority-head radio-false and exception tests proving queue/reservations/stats and at-most-once behavior.
notes: Also reproduced cancellation during CAD/backoff before reserve/cleanup: the cancelled send frame and unresolved reservation remain queued and may transmit after caller cancellation/retry. Fix must cover every post-enqueue await, not only radio.transmit exceptions, and prove exact reservation cleanup without unsafe unrelated delivery.
